title: What's new in SCM: Overview (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction and overview of new SCM capabilities
Subcontracting enhancements: comments, attachments, and inventory put-away
Planning worksheet and automatic production order creation
Manufacturing improvements: routing certification and machine center calendar
Direct transfer orders: new posting modes and flexibility
Inventory put-away and pick for direct transfers
Quality inspection enhancements: user roles and workflow automation

features.name: Subcontracting comments and attachments on purchase lines
features.description: Suppliers receive detailed comments and attached documents from routing operations on purchase order lines, instructing them on how to perform subcontracted operations.
caveats: Comments and attachments flow from routing to production order to purchase document

features.name: Inventory put-away for subcontracted operations
features.description: Received subcontracted items can be handled with inventory put-aways in addition to normal posting and warehouse receipts, supporting both last and non-last operations.
caveats: Serial numbers can only be specified for last operations
Non-last operations do not support serial number specification

features.name: Create released production orders from planning worksheet
features.description: The planning worksheet now allows creating production orders directly in released status or released and print status via the carry out action message, with automatic consumption based on flushing method configuration.
features.status_evidence_quote: I can create production orders in status released or released and print
caveats: Automatic consumption occurs when status is released
Requires careful configuration of flushing methods to avoid unintended automatic posting

features.name: Dynamic field visibility for parallel routings
features.description: When a routing type is changed from serial to parallel, the previous and next operations fields become visible automatically without requiring manual personalization.

features.name: Machine center calendar entries availability check
features.description: A new field on the machine center card shows when calendar entries are available until, displayed in red when insufficient data exists. The calculate machine center calendar report can be run directly from the card.
caveats: Report is pre-filtered and uses current work year as starting date

features.name: Direct transfer posting modes selection
features.description: Direct transfers now support choosing between direct posting mode (one-go, one-to-one posting) or shipment and receipt mode (separate documents with partial shipping support).
caveats: Previously, shipment and receipt mode was blocked for direct transfers
Warehouse handling differs by posting mode

features.name: Partial shipment for direct transfer shipment and receipt mode
features.description: When using direct transfer with shipment and receipt mode, users can partially ship goods instead of being forced to ship all quantities.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is a benefit of direct transfer of mode ship and receipt. It supports partial shipping
caveats: Only available when shipment and receipt mode is selected

features.name: Transfer route specification for direct transfer mode
features.description: Transfer routes now include fields to specify direct transfer mode (direct or shipment and receipt) with values defaulting from inventory posting setup but overridable per route.
features.status_evidence_quote: these two fields are now available in the on the transfer route specification. And I can change it and decide to use shipment and
caveats: Default values come from inventory posting setup
Can be overridden for specific transfer documents

features.name: In-transit location for transfers
features.description: Transfer orders can now define and use an in-transit location code, allowing item ledger entries to have a populated location code instead of blank entries.
caveats: Eliminates the need for blank location code entries in inventory posting setup

features.name: Location code copy to value entries for manufacturing
features.description: Manufacturing operations now copy location codes to value entries linked to capacity ledger entries, ensuring location code is always populated in manufacturing-related value entries.
caveats: Eliminates need for empty location code entries in inventory posting setup

features.name: Inventory put-away and pick for partial transfers
features.description: Users can create inventory put-aways and picks for both outbound and inbound transfers with support for partial quantities.
caveats: Requires location to be configured for put-away and pick
Can be used for partial shipments

features.name: Quality inspection blocking transfers
features.description: Transfer orders are blocked when a quality inspection has a failed result, preventing movement of items that have not passed inspection.
caveats: Only applies to items with item tracking
Navigation to quality inspection details is available

features.name: Quality inspection user role permissions
features.description: Quality inspection apps provide multiple roles: inspector (performs inspection), administrator (modifies fields like sample size and failed/passed quantities, assigns inspections, reopens or deletes finished inspections), with normal users having restricted modification capabilities.
caveats: Role-based restrictions apply to field modifications
Administrators have broader permissions than inspectors

features.name: Quality inspection auto-assignment recommendation
features.description: When a quality inspection header is modified, the system recommends assigning the inspection to the current user, which can be accepted with one click.

features.name: Quality inspection passed/failed quantity auto-update
features.description: When a quality inspection is finished with a passed result, the passed quantity is automatically updated from the sample size, and previously failed quantities are preserved for workflow usage.
caveats: Values are used in workflows
Failed quantity initialization uses previous inspection results
